answer: Continuous Proof-of-Burn deters Sybils in an agent market, even one trading pigment analyses of a fragile relic. To gain or renew epoch eligibility, an agent destroys native tokens at an unspendable address tied to its public key and epoch, which the settlement kernel verifies before admitting the key. Because burned tokens are unrecoverable, attackers incur an irreversible financial cost per fake identity, though wealthy adversaries can still outspend and exclude low-capital peers.
